roles.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
responsibilities: Sets company strategy and leads the management team.

roles.title: Sales Manager
responsibilities: Leads the sales team and key customer accounts.

roles.title: Sales Representative
responsibilities: Prepares customer quotes and manages customer relationships.

roles.title: Operations Manager
responsibilities: Approves departmental purchase needs and business necessity.

roles.title: Finance Manager
responsibilities: Validates amounts, policy rules, and required approvals.

roles.title: Accountant
responsibilities: Matches supplier invoices to purchase orders and processes payments.

roles.title: Procurement Manager
responsibilities: Selects vendors and approves purchase orders.

roles.title: Procurement Specialist
responsibilities: Requests vendor quotes and places purchase orders.

relationships.description: Procurement sends supplier invoices to Finance for payment once an order is placed.

evidence.quote: Once the order is placed, Procurement sends the supplier invoice to Finance for payment.

relationships.description: Sales sends approved quotes to Finance for a credit check before order confirmation.

evidence.quote: Approved quotes are sent to Finance, which checks the customer's credit limit before the order is confirmed.
